## File: facebookresearch_detic/third_party/Deformable-DETR/datasets/torchvision_datasets/coco.py

Prompts

```
['create a CocoDetection dataset instance with a root directory and COCO annotation JSON file', 'cache all COCO dataset images into memory for faster repeated access during training', 'retrieve a single COCO image by file path from cache or disk as an RGB PIL Image', 'get a dataset item by index returning a tuple of the image and its COCO annotations', 'get the total number of images in the COCO dataset by calling len on the dataset']
```

